integrity: The theorem has a complete self-contained proof. Standalone finite BFS checker verifies 2000 moduli but is not an infinite proof. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only full-support moduli are classified. The size of the image when the modulus is divisible by six, and ordinary asymptotic density of the orbit, remain undetermined. Implicit earlier derivability from general semigroup theory is a residual originality risk.
title: A sharp congruence-locality dichotomy for a Klarner affine orbit
